Class MzMLReader

java.lang.Object
global.thalion.ttio.importers.MzMLReader
public class MzMLReader extends Object
SAX-based mzML 1.1 parser. Produces an AcquisitionRun from an mzML document, decoding binary data arrays, cvParam metadata, and chromatograms.

API status: Stable.

Cross-language equivalents:
Objective-C: TTIOMzMLReader · Python: ttio.importers.mzml

  • Field Details

    • PROGRESS_INTERVAL_SPECTRA

      public static final int PROGRESS_INTERVAL_SPECTRA
      Default emit-every-N cadence for ProgressSink callbacks. Spectra are heavier than reads (peaks + intensities + m/z arrays per spectrum), so the cadence is intentionally coarser than Stage B's 1000-reads to keep overhead negligible while still giving visible updates on multi-thousand-spectrum files.

    • read

      public static AcquisitionRun read(File file, ProgressSink progress) throws MzMLParseException, IOException
      Parse an mzML file, firing progress.onProgress(spectraDone, -1L) every PROGRESS_INTERVAL_SPECTRA <spectrum> closing tags and a final onProgress(total, total) once the spectrum count is known. Total is reported as -1L mid-parse because mzML's spectrumList count attribute is not always present or trustworthy; the final fire stamps both done and total with the true count.
      Throws:
      MzMLParseException
      IOException
      Since:
      1.5.0
